captions.detailed: This 3D model shows a single half of a sphericon geometric solid. It features a flat, semi-circular mating surface on one side and a curved, conical-like outer surface on the other, tapering to defined vertices. The flat face is designed to be paired with a matching half to form a complete sphericon.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric sphericon in OpenSCAD with adjustable parameters for the order (number of segments), overall diameter, and a toggle to generate either a single half or a full joined sphericon. Include options for pin-joint alignment holes along the mating surface and an internal hollowed-out sphere to save material.
captions.factory: The script defines a 'half_sphericon' module that constructs the segmented conical profile using a for-loop of 'cylinder' primitives with varying heights and radii, rotated and subtracted by a 'cube' to create a flat mating plane. In the main scope, two of these halves can be unioned with an angular offset. A 'difference' operation then subtracts a central 'sphere' to hollow out the interior and uses a loop of small 'cylinder' primitives to drill alignment pin holes into the flat face.
